name: Cloak of Smoke
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 7th; Slot shoulders; Price 30,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

An ornate cloak from the lands of the Unseen Court, this cloak fills the air around the wearer with a constant roil of smoke, granting the wearer concealment.

The wearer can see through the smoke without trouble, and can dismiss or invoke the smoke as a free action.

In addition the wearer receives a +2 deflection bonus to AC.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, solid fog; Cost 15,000 gp.
